deploy_app_sglang: deploy an LLM application using SGLang with a Ray router actor and worker replicas on a cluster
create_SglangRouterActor: create a Ray remote router actor that launches an SGLang router process and monitors worker replicas
create_SglangActor: create a Ray remote worker actor that starts an SGLang inference server subprocess with tensor and pipeline parallelism
update_replicas_SglangRouterActor: update the SGLang router by adding running worker replicas and removing dead ones via HTTP calls
kill_actor: kill a Ray actor handle by calling its remote kill method and then calling ray.kill on the handle
